questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the quantized plateau? Ext. Data Fig. 7 (p. 26) answers this (more than 60 fabricated, 11 measured, 2 with a plateau); how many cooldowns and datasets does that cover?
Why were the others set aside? Ext. Data Fig. 7 gives working gates and "good basic transport" as the criterion for the 11; did any of the others show zero-bias peaks?
Which ranges of field, field angle and the three gates did you measure beyond those in Figs. 1 to 4, and what does the zero-bias conductance do there?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like, for example the best of the nine devices without a plateau?
What series resistance, if any, did you subtract in Figs. 1 to 4, how was it calibrated, and what do Figs. 2b and 4b look like raw?
How did you find the gate settings of Figs. 1b and 2a, and do other settings in device A give peaks that level off above or below 2e^2/h?
For device B, how did you estimate the second-channel background, and what is the net peak height across Fig. 4b?
Did you look for dot resonances above the gap in devices A and B, as Ext. Data Fig. 4b does for device C?
